final: WITH event_counts AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event), totals AS (SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS total_count FROM event_counts) SELECT ec.event_id, ec.attendance_count, 1.0 * ec.attendance_count / t.total_count AS share FROM event_counts AS ec CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
